VR.title: Quest 3 Headsets Are Heading To The International Space Station
VR.summary: Two Quest 3 headsets are heading to the International Space Station to train astronauts for spacewalks, marking a collaboration between Meta and the European Space Agency.

VR.title: Meta is Spinning out ‘Supernatural’ a Mere 3 Years After $400M Acquisition
VR.summary: Meta has spun out the VR fitness app Supernatural into an independent company, Supernatural Health, reuniting the original founders and coaches.

VR.title: X-Plane & iRacing PC VR Streaming Clients Launched For Apple Vision Pro
VR.summary: X-Plane 12 and iRacing are now playable in VR on Apple Vision Pro, enabling immersive streaming from PC with physical accessories.

VR.title: This Quest Accessory Wants to Turn Your Brain Activity Into VR Avatar Control
VR.summary: PiEEG is launching a brain-computer interface for Quest headsets, allowing users to control avatars with brain signals and facial expressions.

VR.title: James Cameron’s 3D Studio Acquires 3D Camera Maker STEREOTEC
VR.summary: James Cameron's Lightstorm Vision has acquired 3D camera maker STEREOTEC to enhance its 3D production capabilities.

VR.title: ‘Beat Saber’ Turns 8, Bringing 3 New Free Tracks to VR’s Favorite Block-slashing Rhythm Game
VR.summary: To celebrate its 8th anniversary, Beat Saber has released three new free tracks for players on Quest and SteamVR.

AI.title: AI leaders call for tougher protections against AI-aided bioweapons
AI.summary: Major AI industry leaders are urging US lawmakers to implement stricter regulations to prevent the misuse of AI technology in developing bioweapons.

AI.title: Amazon develops a warehouse robot that workers can speak to
AI.summary: Amazon has unveiled a new version of its autonomous warehouse robot, Proteus, which can now interact with workers using natural language.

AI.title: Microsoft and OpenAI broke up — now they’re ready to fight
AI.summary: Microsoft announced new AI initiatives, including a super app and in-house reasoning models, signaling its competitive stance against OpenAI.

AI.title: Google must let publishers opt out of AI Search features, rules UK
AI.summary: A UK ruling now allows online publishers to opt out of Google's AI Search features, giving them more control over their content.

AI.title: AI has a water problem — Google thinks it has a fix
AI.summary: Google is addressing environmental concerns related to AI data centers by committing to increase water availability for local communities.

AI.title: TSMC struggles to keep up with AI demand: ‘We can only support so much’
AI.summary: TSMC is struggling to meet the soaring demand for AI chips, despite ongoing factory expansions in the US.

NFL.title: QB Wilson announces retirement after 14 seasons
NFL.summary: Ten-time Pro Bowl quarterback Russell Wilson has announced his retirement from the NFL to join CBS Sports.

NFL.title: Christian Watson, Packers agree to four-year extension
NFL.summary: Packers wide receiver Christian Watson has agreed to a four-year contract extension worth $110.5 million, with $31 million guaranteed.

NFL.title: Sources: TE Washington, Steelers reach 4-yr. deal
NFL.summary: The Pittsburgh Steelers have reached a four-year, $42 million extension with tight end Darnell Washington.

NFL.title: Niners' Kittle targets Week 1, says he's 'on track...
NFL.summary: 49ers tight end George Kittle is optimistic about returning for Week 1 after recovering from a torn Achilles.

NFL.title: Rams, Myles Garrett execute a new contract
NFL.summary: Myles Garrett has secured a new contract with the Rams, receiving a $6.5 million raise for the 2026 season.

NFL.title: Lions rookie WR Kendrick Law tore his ACL
NFL.summary: Lions rookie wide receiver Kendrick Law has torn his ACL, delaying his NFL debut until 2027.
